title: Special Rules on Registration Matters of Corporations
full_text:
## SPECIAL RULES ON REGISTERED MATTERS OF CORPORATIONS, ETC.

Reference law: KR:001184 / Subsidiary rule KR:005859. Existing W04 drafts reused without retranslation; only deleted attachment status entries newly authored. Source version: 266773. The original is preserved; version matching and QA are deferred.

### ARTICLE:1:0:00001

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the enforcement of the Act on Special Cases concerning Registered Matters of Corporations, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). [Amended on March 23, 2006, and November 29, 2024.]

### ARTICLE:2:0:00002

Article 2 (Registration concerning Korean Nationals Residing Abroad and Foreigners)
When registering an officer, member, person conducting business, or liquidator of a corporation, if that officer, member, person conducting business, or liquidator is a Korean national residing abroad or a foreigner who has no resident registration number, the foreigner registration number, domestic residence report number, or date of birth shall be registered. [Amended on April 9, 2012, and November 29, 2024.]

### ARTICLE:3:0:00003

Article 3 (Matters to Be Registered concerning Branch Offices or Branches)
The term "other matters prescribed by Supreme Court Rules" in Article 3 (1) 2 of the Act means the name of a branch office or branch, where such name is stated in the application.

### ADDENDUM:01246:19921230:00001

Addendum <Supreme Court Rule No. 1246, December 30, 1992>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 1993.

Article 2 (Conversion of Registration Folios for Branch Offices)
(1) Registration folios for branch offices existing at the time these Rules enter into force (hereinafter referred to as "old registration folios") shall be converted by December 31, 1993 into registration folios for branch offices under these Rules (hereinafter referred to as "new registration folios").
(2) The conversion under paragraph (1) shall be made by transferring to the new registration folio, from among the registered matters currently in effect, the matters required by the Act to be registered at a branch office.
(3) Where registered matters have been transferred under paragraph (2), the fact of transfer and its date shall be entered in both registration folios pursuant to Article 2 (2) of the Addenda to the Enforcement Rules of the Act on Special Cases concerning Registered Matters of Corporations, etc.; the registrar shall affix his or her seal, and the old registration folio shall be closed.

Article 3 (Transitional Measures Pending Conversion of Registration Folios)
Where an application for registration or an application for issuance of a certified copy or extract is filed in respect of a registration folio before it is converted under Article 2 of these Addenda, the application shall be processed after the registered matters have been transferred to a new registration folio pursuant to that Article.

### ADDENDUM:01595:19990312:00002

Addendum <Supreme Court Rule No. 1595, March 12, 1999>

### ADDENDUM:02008:20060323:00003

Addendum <Supreme Court Rule No. 2008, March 23, 2006>
(1) (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on April 1, 2006.
(2) (Transitional Provisions) Cases pending at the time these Rules enter into force shall be governed by the previous practice.

### ADDENDUM:03172:20241129:00006

Addendum <Supreme Court Rule No. 3172, November 29, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on January 31, 2025.

Article 2 (Special Cases concerning Closure, etc. of Registration Records of Principal Offices and Head Offices)
With respect to registration records of branch offices (including branches; hereinafter the same shall apply) for which the registration records of the principal office (including the head office; hereinafter the same shall apply) had been closed, or whose records have been damaged or destroyed and require correction at the time the Act Partially Amending the Act on Special Cases concerning Registered Matters of Corporations, etc., Act No. 20434 (hereinafter referred to as the "Amended Act"), enters into force, a registrar may close or correct the records ex officio.

Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Registration Records of Branch Offices, etc.)
(1) In order to implement the transitional measures under Article 3 of the Addenda to the Amended Act, a Judicial Registration Deliberation Officer shall collectively handle registration affairs, including transferring matters concerning agents and managers of branch offices to the registration records of the principal office and closing the registration records of branch offices.
(2) Where an error or omitted registered matter is found in processing under paragraph (1), a registrar shall correct it ex officio.

Article 4 (Special Cases concerning Reinstatement of Closed Registration Records of Branch Offices)
(1) Where liquidation affairs remain outstanding or a judgment invalidating a dissolution exists, etc., the representative of a corporation may apply to the registry office having jurisdiction over the location of its principal office for matters concerning agents and managers contained in a registration record of a branch office closed before the Amended Act entered into force to be transferred to the registration record of the principal office.
(2) In a case under paragraph (1), the closed registration record of the branch office shall not be reinstated; instead, the relevant matters shall be transferred to the registration record of the principal office.
(3) Where a registrar transfers registered matters under paragraph (1), the registrar shall record the fact and date of the transfer in the relevant section of the registration record of the principal office.
